title: The confirmed controllers against their teachers on the validation episodes
description: experiments/versus_reference.py over the scoring rollouts of the references and widths of exp-ground-rl-confirm-32 and of the teachers themselves (Cubic and BBRv3, exp-teachers-val-35), on the same 21 validation links under 6 conditions with the same seeds. Each width is set against its teacher's reference as in exp-ground-rl-confirm-32 (paired by link, bootstrap 95% interval over links, the verdict by the margin of 0.1), and each reference and width also gets its signed difference from its teacher, over the conditions without a competing flow and over those with one, with no verdict: the teachers were not trained on this objective (docs/methodology.md, comparing controllers, rule 4). The share with a competing flow is given for every controller, the teachers included. What is read: where the controllers stand against the teachers they were cloned from, by kind of condition, and how the teachers' share compares with the references'. The test links are not read.
